title: Authorize public football-data acquisition for private development and research

source.execution_instruction: CURRENT_TASK.md section 7; repository-owner correction accompanying the original V4 reference

authorizes: investigate and use technically viable public football-data routes for private development, research, historical and rich-data acquisition, provider comparison and live-data experimentation

use official APIs, undocumented public JSON and browser endpoints, public HTML and embedded state, public CSV/JSON feeds, open datasets, maintained community wrappers and scrapers, and normal public request formats
perform bounded investigation and acquisition within the V4 programme without requiring routine approval for each already-authorized request
determine actual resource access and usefulness empirically rather than rejecting a source solely because an official API or commercial integration is unavailable
requires: respect applicable source use conditions, entitlements, attribution, retention and request restrictions
retain exact source bytes or text, checksums, native identifiers, request and acquisition times and processing versions
reuse existing request bounds, cache, quotas, cooldowns, immutable storage, normalization and work orchestration
qualify identity, statistic semantics and point-in-time eligibility before canonical or model use
record tested access routes and exact blockers without fabricating access, observations, qualified coverage or market probabilities
preserve historical decisions and frozen evidence and apply this policy prospectively
explicitly_not_authorized: defeating authentication, CAPTCHAs, paywalls or explicit technical restrictions
changing MatchForge internal admin/API authentication, browser Origin checks, private-local controls, owner approvals or request validation
publishing third-party source data without permission
reopening closed scientific routes, accessing sealed outcomes, changing frozen evaluation budgets or automatically promoting models
production Architecture V2 cutover or legacy retirement without their existing gates and explicit approval
supersession: Prospectively clarify current development acquisition policy and already-authorized V4 request scope. Earlier source/evaluation evidence remains unchanged; an official API is not a prerequisite for investigation.
